summary: Enhance your NGO's impact with our Governance and Accountability training course. Learn best practices to ensure transparency and effective management.
lede: NGO governance and accountability training helps board members and senior staff assess oversight, clarify responsibilities, and strengthen reporting. Participants practice governance health assessments, map accountability relationships with funders and beneficiaries, develop board committee charters, and plan financial controls, risk oversight, and practical implementation steps for their organizations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for mid-to-senior professionals who carry direct governance, accountability, or compliance responsibility within NGOs, civil society organizations, foundations, and development agencies. It is equally relevant to those who sit on governing boards and those who support board operations from within management.
audience: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) Managers
modules: NGO Governance Landscape and Failure Patterns
Governance Health Assessment and Diagnostic Tools
Board Authority, Structure, and the Policy Governance Model
Financial Oversight, Internal Controls, and Audit Readiness
Governance Reform Planning and Board Leadership
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals with existing experience in NGO operations, board service, or civil society management. Participants should have a working familiarity with how NGOs are structured and funded. Specific prerequisites include: Minimum 2–3 years of professional experience in an NGO, civil society organization, foundation, or development agency; Basic familiarity with board or committee structures (direct board service experience is beneficial but not required); Working knowledge of donor reporting processes and grant management cycles; No accounting qualification is required; financial literacy at the level of reading a budget and understanding an audit report is sufficient; No coding or technical software skills are required; participants will use pre-configured templates and dashboards provided during the course
